source: Amazon Best Sellers / New Releases（amazon.com，免密钥直抓）
source_zh: 亚马逊畅销榜与新品榜（官方榜单页直抓，含排名、平均评分、累计评论数）

framework_zh: 累计评分人数（reviews）。一个商品被多少人评价过，是「有多少人在谈论/购买」最直接的公开代理指标。
平均星级（rating）。衡量这些谈论是偏正面还是偏负面。换算为 3.5 星=0 分、5.0 星=1 分的线性刻度。
榜单名次。畅销榜反映当下正在卖得动的程度；新品榜反映正在起量的新面孔。名次越靠前分越高。
framework_en: Cumulative rating count — the most direct public proxy for how many people are talking about and buying an item.
Average star rating — whether that chatter is positive. Scaled linearly from 3.5★ = 0 to 5.0★ = 1.
Leaderboard rank — current sales velocity on the Best Sellers board, and emerging demand on the New Releases board.
method.formula_zh: buzz 综合分 = 0.45×声量分 + 0.30×口碑分 + 0.25×动能分（各分量先归一化到 0–1）
method.why_weights_zh: 声量权重最高，因为「多少人买过」比「少数人打几分」更难被操纵，也更能代表真实的市场渗透；口碑次之；名次权重最低，因为榜单名次波动最快、噪声最大。
method.why_weights_en: Volume carries the most weight because how many people bought is harder to game than how a few people rated; rank carries the least because it is the noisiest and moves fastest.
limits_zh: 只有累计评论数，没有评论增速 —— 因此本分析回答「谁已经火了」，不能回答「谁正在变火」。真正的增速需要历史快照，本项目靠每轮运行逐步积累。
评论数受上架时间影响：老品的累计评论天然更高。跨品类比较时已按榜单内归一化处理，但仍不宜把「评论多」直接等同于「更受欢迎」。
Amazon 榜单是「销量排名」，不是销售额排名，低价高频商品（如杀虫剂、泳池药剂）天然占优。这正是总榜头部被耗材占据的原因。
一手数据只覆盖 Amazon 与 Walmart 两个渠道。Home Depot、Lowe's、Costco 的站内数据无法直抓（已整体移出对标，见第十二章），因此本页不提供跨渠道份额口径，也不把任何两家的原始分直接混算。
limits_en: Only cumulative ratings, no velocity — this answers who is already big, not who is accelerating. True momentum needs historical snapshots, which this project accrues run by run.
Rating counts favour older listings. Comparisons are normalised within each board, but 'more reviews' still does not mean 'more loved'.

Amazon boards rank by units, not revenue, so cheap high-frequency consumables (insecticides, pool chemicals) are structurally advantaged — which is exactly why the overall board is topped by consumables.

First-party data covers Amazon and Walmart only. Home Depot, Lowe's and Costco cannot be scraped on-site and have been dropped from the comparison entirely (see section 12), so no cross-channel share metric is offered and no two channels' raw scores are ever blended.

notes.consumable_zh: 亚马逊「庭院与户外」总榜前六名全部是杀虫类耗材（Zevo、TERRO、Ortho）。这不是数据错误 —— 该榜按销售件数排，低单价、高复购、全年刚需的耗材天然压过单价高、一次性购买的大件家具。看家具要看子类榜，别看总榜。
notes.consumable_en: The top six of Amazon's overall Patio, Lawn & Garden board are all insect-control consumables (Zevo, TERRO, Ortho). This is not a data error: the board ranks by units, so cheap, repeat-purchase, year-round essentials structurally outrank one-off big-ticket furniture. Read the sub-category boards for furniture, not the overall board.
notes.category_zh: Amazon 的「Patio Furniture & Accessories」节点并非纯家具 —— 它把冷藏箱、保温冰袋、露营椅也算进来了。因此本页在做家具分析时按标题关键词重新归了类，并单独列出分类结果，避免把冷藏箱当成户外家具。
notes.category_en: Amazon's 'Patio Furniture & Accessories' node is not purely furniture — it also contains coolers, ice packs and camping chairs. Products are therefore re-categorised by title keywords here, and the resulting split is shown explicitly so coolers are not mistaken for outdoor furniture.

channels.strength_zh: 公开畅销榜与评分数据最完整，长尾第三方品牌密集，价格透明、比价压力最大
channels.strength_en: Most complete public leaderboards and ratings data; dense long tail of third-party brands; fully transparent pricing
channels.brand_zh: 以第三方品牌与白牌为主（Zevo、TERRO、POLYWOOD、GCI 等）
channels.access_zh: 8 个畅销榜 / 新品榜可直抓；商品详情页有 captcha，主图取不到，所以配图统一用沃尔玛侧
channels.access_en: Eight best-seller / new-release boards scrape cleanly; product detail pages serve a captcha and main images are unavailable, so photos come from Walmart

channels.strength_zh: 大件家具与遮阳的铺货厚度全场最高，中端自有品牌密集，价格带整体低于亚马逊；但评价水位明显更浅（中位评价数 122 条 vs 亚马逊 5,528 条），口碑样本更薄
channels.strength_en: Deepest assortment in bulky furniture and shade, dense mid-tier private labels and a lower price band than Amazon — but far shallower review coverage (median 122 ratings vs Amazon's 5,528), so sentiment samples are thinner
channels.brand_zh: Better Homes & Gardens / Mainstays / Ozark Trail / Expert Grill / Hyper Tough
channels.brand_en: Better Homes & Gardens / Mainstays / Ozark Trail / Expert Grill / Hyper Tough
channels.access_zh: 7 个 patio 品类页直抓（296 件）；评论页支持「最低分优先」排序，是负评归纳的数据源。⚠️ 站内有速率风控，页间隔需 12–16 秒
channels.access_en: Seven patio category pages scrape cleanly (296 items); the review pages support a lowest-rating-first sort, which powers the complaint analysis. Rate-limited: 12–16s between pages

channels.strength_zh: 自有品牌主导户外线，线下门店可现场试坐验货，大件配送与门店自提形成便利性优势
channels.strength_en: Private labels lead outdoor; physical stores allow try-before-buy; delivery and curbside pickup are the convenience edge
channels.brand_zh: Hampton Bay / Stylewell / Home Decorators Collection / Martha Stewart
channels.brand_en: Hampton Bay / Stylewell / Home Decorators Collection / Martha Stewart
channels.access_zh: 站内被 Akamai 拦截，robots.txt 亦返回 403；只有 IR / 新闻稿等公开披露材料可读
channels.access_en: On-site pages are blocked by Akamai and even robots.txt returns 403; only public disclosures (IR, press releases) are readable

channels.strength_zh: allen + roth 一个品牌覆盖绝大部分户外品类，风格跨度大、促销折扣力度常高于同业
channels.strength_en: A single allen + roth label spans most outdoor categories, with wide style range and frequently deeper promotions
channels.brand_zh: allen + roth（主力）/ Style Selections / 联名 POLYWOOD
channels.brand_en: allen + roth (core) / Style Selections / POLYWOOD collab
channels.access_zh: 整站返回 403（含 robots.txt），无头浏览器与多个代理通道同样被拒
channels.access_en: The whole site returns 403 (robots.txt included); headless browsers and several proxy routes were refused as well

channels.data_tier_zh: 受限（客户端渲染，无服务端数据）
channels.strength_zh: SKU 极窄、季节性上架，走仓店大包装与限时特价；单款议价能力强，但可选款式与尺寸远少于专业家居建材渠道，复购与配件生态也弱
channels.strength_en: Extremely narrow SKU count, seasonal listings, warehouse bulk packs and time-limited deals. Strong bargaining power per item, but far fewer styles and sizes than home-improvement specialists, with a weak accessory ecosystem
channels.brand_zh: Sunvilla / Agio / Lifetime 等仓店专供与联名款
channels.brand_en: Warehouse-exclusive and collab labels such as Sunvilla / Agio / Lifetime
channels.access_zh: 页面为纯客户端渲染，HTML 里只有约 350 处 Skeleton 占位、无任何商品数据；三个内部接口均返回 404。本节只做定性描述，不填任何数字
